To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

(1) the architecture, design, and key technologies underlying the existing databases and Web applications are different and have their unique strengths and weaknesses, and (2) some of the emerging technologies such as Semantic Web and Web services have the potential to address some of the persistent problems of data integration

the emerging technologies and design concepts are likely to have an important role in systems driven biomedical research and will help researchers to integrate and analyze data in a more efficient way.

the current trends in the development of computational infrastructure for systems driven biological research include the following: (1) the use of Web services and Web 2.0 technologies; (2) the development of new database and data mining techniques; (3) the integration of data from different sources; and (4) the use of new technologies such as cloud computing and semantic Web.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the design and architecture of database and Web application for systems driven biomedical research.
the design and development of novel computational infrastructure for systems driven biological research.
the design and architecture of the computational infrastructure that can support the systems driven research and provide an efficient platform to integrate data from different sources.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the existing technology is capable of addressing the challenges posed by systems driven biomedical research but the future of this technology is not clear.
the existing databases and Web applications are still far from the ideal.
there is no single database or Web application that can address all the needs of systems driven biomedical researchers.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we have tried to present the current state of the art in database and Web applications and have also highlighted the new trends and challenges in the design of such systems.
the future of systems-driven biomedical research will be driven by the computational technologies and approaches that are currently in the development stage.
there is no silver bullet to the problems of data integration, however the emerging technologies are likely to have an important role in the near future.
The main takeaway from our work is that

a new generation of computational technologies is emerging to address the persistency of problems and to meet the challenges posed by dynamic nature of systems driven biomedical and clinical research.
the existing databases and Web applications have been developed to meet specific research needs and are not suitable for all applications.
the current technologies are capable of meeting the expectations and requirements of the systems driven biological research, but there are some limitations and issues which need to be addressed.
